Name: quest_101
Description: Myad recently told you about the epidemic in the village, and said that Seyon might be able to help.

Name: quest_102
Description: Seyon said that the mushrooms started to rot after a group of suspicious people garbed in red were camping near them. Let's search the area around the mushrooms for clues.

Name: quest_103
Description: You discovered this peculiar emblem near the mushrooms. You better show this to Myad.

Name: quest_104
Description: Just like Seyon said, those suspicious strangers were also seen by Myad. Myad told you to meet Karitte at the Tower of Luxem Valley.

Name: quest_105
Description: Karitte said that the epidemic is actually a curse. An antidote needs to be created, so you'll have to collect 10 Pumpkin Seeds for Karitte.

Name: quest_106
Description: You have to complete this quest before the Soil of Purification and Antidote lose their effectiveness. There's not much time left, so you better place the Soil of Purification a

Name: quest_107
Description: Myad has asked you to save Pony and Ronk. You're running out of time, so you've got to bring the antidote to them.

Name: quest_108
Description: Myad said that Zant Village seems to be cursed too. He's asked you to give the Antidote Recipe to Lena.

Name: quest_109
Description: Lena, a descendant of Lillith, said that the dark force around Zant Village is caused by a witch staying in the Tower of Luxem Valley. Lena said that Karitte must be stopped, and is spreading bad rumors about her. You should see Karitte first.

Name: quest_110
Description: Karitte told you a totally different story than Lena. Something else is behind the dark force affecting the Canyon City. Karitte has told you to check up on Luth, who is well known for causing trouble in Zant.

Name: quest_111
Description: Why was Luth so angry with you, and what could be so special about the hourglass he's mentioned? You better ask Lena and find out what you can.

Name: quest_112
Description: According to Lena, Luth messed around with the hourglass in Zant and took the Crystal Key. You better question Luth and see if you can get the Crystal Key back.

Name: quest_113
Description: That cowardly Luth! How could he throw away the Crystal Key because of a Woopie? Could the big, grey Woopie have been the Woopie King? Hurry and find the Crystal Key!

Name: quest_114
Description: Lena told you to put the Crystal Key into the hourglass. You'll need to search for the hourglass and its keyhole.

Name: quest_115
Description: Lena recognizes her mistake, and she has asked you to apologize to Karitte for her before she visits her in person.

Name: quest_116
Description: Karitte has asked you to meet Harin in Junon Polis, and find out if she's really her older sister.

Name: quest_117
Description: To earn Harin's trust, you've decided to help her by finding Bellia, the Gypsy Jewel Seller, so you can get some sort of secret medicine.

Name: quest_118
Description: Bellia asks you to get 20 Sharp Stingers and 20 Wild Animal Claws to make the secret medicine. Hunt Queen Bibis and Queen HoneyBees to find Sharp Stingers, and Fighter Rackies for the Wild Animal Claws.

Name: quest_119
Description: Bellia has asked you to ask Harin about the Gypsy Permit she gave to you. You need to speak to Harin and see if you can learn who issued that permit.

Name: quest_120
Description: Harin asks you to steal Dreadful Book Vol.2 from Bellia during the night. Bellia has bad eyesight, so you probably won't get caught if you're careful.

Name: quest_121
Description: Harin says that she'll need Five-Color Scales to make the secret medicine. Hunt Aqua Warriors to get these Five-Color Scales.

Name: quest_122
Description: You finally have the secret medicine! But there's something suspicious about being asked to sprinkle it around the pyramid in the El Verloon Desert to revive Alex…

Name: quest_123
Description: The hideous monster that appeared after sprinkling the Resurrection Medicine was carrying a small necklace and an emblem that's similar to the one you found while investigating the incident involving the cursed mushrooms. You'd better show these to Harin.

Name: quest_124
Description: You must confront Shroon, possibly the mastermind of this entire plot, who is in the Shrine in Anima Lake which is North of Junon Polis.

Name: quest_125
Description: Shroon has denied any knowledge about Alex. You better let Harin know about this.

Name: quest_126
Description: Harin says that Shroon is still continuing to research dark magic. She asks you to deliver a letter to Bellia, who might be able to deal with Shroon.

Name: quest_127
Description: With a background in alchemy, Bellia is taking a very methodical approach in dealing with Shroon. To learn Shroon's secrets, Bellia asks you

Name: quest_128
Description: Now that you've brought the Gold Fragments, you need fruit from Guardian Trees to complete the Owl Eye. Go to the Forest of Wisdom and get 10 fruit from the Guardian Trees.

Name: quest_129
Description: Now that you've got the completed Owl Eye, you need to hide it someplace where it can watch Shroon. Be careful: If you're caught, all your efforts will be for nothing!

Name: quest_130
Description: Bellia realizes the power of Shroon's magic and recommends that you get Eva to help you. Hopefully, you can persuade Eva, a woman who abandoned magic and is now living as a Guide, to help you.

Name: quest_131
Description: Something seems to be blocking the power of the Owl Eye. You need for get 20 Flames of Courage from Kaiman Warriors, and 5 Flames of Passion from Grunter Kings, to penetrate the darkness that's interfering with the Owl Eye.

Name: quest_132
Description: Eva believes that Shroon may be trying to contract with a demon which may present a dangerous scenario. While Eva looks into other ways to deal with Shroon, you've got to try to convince Shroon to cancel this contract.

Name: quest_133
Description: In the end, you weren't able to dissuade the stubborn Shroon. You'd better meet with Eva and see how she's doing.

Name: quest_134
Description: Surprisingly, Eva understands Shroon's plans and you now know that Shroon's secret is in the Pyramid in El Verloon Desert. But since Shroon protected that area with a barrier, you'll need 15 Bottles of Odorous Sweat. Be careful, they smell terrible!

Name: quest_135
Description: Eva placed a spell on the Odorous Sweat so that even the dead can smell it. Hurry and sprinkle it around the Pyramid before Shroon notices.

Name: quest_136
Description: Eva says that the Red Heart is the medium for Shroon's spell. While Eva deals with the spell, you've got to try to talk to Shroon again.

Name: quest_137
Description: Shroon seems angered that you've foiled his plans. Although you've won this time, who knows what Shroon may do in the future. For now, you'd better meet Eva.

Name: quest_138
Description: Eva will be using the Owl Eye to watch Shroon from now on. You should return to Harin so you can tell her everything that happened.

Name: quest_139
Description: Harin heard everything about Shroon, and has now asked you to help Punwell in the Windmill Village.

Name: quest_140
Description: Punwell says that the Zeppastone Wind Gem is necessary for the prosperity of the Windmill Village. All you know is that the Zeppastone should be in a dark, enclosed place.

Name: quest_141
Description: After recovering the Zeppastone, you hear about the runaway Prince of Akram. You should try to talk to Odelo, a Guard in Junon Polis, to learn more.

Name: quest_142
Description: Odelo said that the only trace of the Prince is a Golden Dagger kept by Gallahad in Kenji's Beach.

Name: quest_143
Description: Gallahad suggests that you investigate the area around the Kenji Stone. Find out what you can over there, and return to Gallahad.

Name: quest_144
DisplayName: The Truth of the Golden Dagger
Description: To find out the truth about the Golden Dagger, you should talk to Lutis, who is in the Valley of Luxem Tower.

Name: quest_145
Description: Lutis started babbling about Luna, but maybe you should visit that planet someday. Now you need to speak to Winters, a Guard in Junon Polis, to continue your search for information on the Golden Dagger.

Name: quest_146
DisplayName: The Truth of the Golden Dagger (2)
Description: You should ask Winters, a Soldier in Junon Polis, about the Golden Dagger.

Name: quest_147
Description: Winters recommended that you see Pavrick, the best craftsman in Luna, to check the Golden Dagger's authenticity. You must ask Alphonso to guide you to Luna.

Name: quest_148
Description: Pavrick confirmed that the Golden Dagger really did belong to the royal family. Hence, the warrior who saved Kenji's Beach was really the Prince. But where is he now? First, you need to return the Golden Dagger to Gallahad.

Name: quest_149
Description: Gallahad told you that Kay, in the Forest of Wisdom, has an interesting proposal for Visitors and that you should visit him. What ever could this proposal be?

Name: quest_150
Description: Kay asks you to get a cup of Lunarian Coffee from Bith in Kenji's Beach if you want to hear more about his secret proposal.

Name: quest_151
Description: The secret to the rich flavor and sumptuous fragrance of Lunarian Coffee is in the Doonga Claws. You've got to get 20 Doonga Claws so that you can get some Lunarian Coffee.

Name: quest_152
Description: You've got to bring this Lunarian Coffee to Kay in 10 minutes before it gets cold. Hurry up!

Name: quest_153
Description: From Kay's pitiable story, you learn that Master Stone Golems have the boxes containing Kay's goods. You need to retrieve 11 boxes from the Master Stone Golems for Kay.

Name: quest_154
Description: Kay asks you to find Med's whereabouts to uncover the secret of the Arumic researchers who withdrew from the Gorge of Silence.

Name: quest_155
Description: Med asks you to find the Mana Chargers that the researchers have hidden in the village. The message 'Wine Barrel,' was inscribed on one of the Chargers. Maybe you should investigate the Bar to find the next hidden Mana Charger.

Name: quest_156
Description: According to Med, Worm Dragons have been chosen to store large amounts of Mana Energy for the Arumics. Fight with about 5 Worm Dragons and search their bodies for Mana Chargers. You can only succeed in this mission by forming a party.

Name: quest_157
Description: According to the message in the Charger, you must now fight Grandmaster Golems. Fight with about 5 Grandmaster Golems and look for Mana Chargers in their dead bodies. You can only complete this task by forming a party.

Name: quest_158
Description: It is said that Hebarn's Red Hearts are sealed in the leaders of the Goblins. Go to the Goblin Cave and fight these high ranked Goblins in order to get at least 3 Red Hearts. You can only succeed by creating a party.

Name: quest_181
Description: samara asked you To bring her Materials ,For Good Reward . She Needs Ghost Oil , Pumpkin head , Candy bag Be fast Before that someone else take it from her

Name: quest_801
Description: You can get a job after reaching character Level 10. Bring your identification papers to Warren in Zant, and he will give you more information.

Name: quest_802
Description: You asked Mildun to teach you the Drive Cart skill, but he has directed you to Mairard. You should go and meet Mairard as soon as you can.

Name: quest_803
Description: Mairard has taught you the history of the Cart. Now, you should ask Luce in Kenji's Beach to teach you about Cart functions.

Name: quest_804
Description: Luce has explained everything about Cart functions to you. Now you can go back to Junon Polis to ask Mildun to teach you the Drive Cart skill.

Name: quest_805
Description: Mildun wants you to hide any documents revealing his involvement in teaching you the Drive Cart skill in the Goblin Cave. Once you've hidden the evidence, return to Mildun.

Name: quest_851
Description: Warren says you cannot become a Soldier unless you receive a recommendation. You should talk to Leonard in Zant in order to obtain one.

Name: quest_852
Description: Leonard wants you to collect 10 HoneyBee Stingers as part of his test to prove you're worthy of becoming a Soldier.

Name: quest_853
Description: Leonard now wants you to fight Elder Pumpkins and bring him 3 Pumpkin Seeds.

Name: quest_854
Description: At last, Leonard has written a recommendation letter for you. With this, Warren will trust you enough to be a Soldier.

Name: quest_855
Description: For the sake of becoming a true Soldier, Raffle has suggested that you complete 3 training exercises. First, you need to defeat 40 Beetles.

Name: quest_856
Description: For the second exercise, you must defeat 15 Dalpings and 15 Ranger Dalpings.

Name: quest_857
Description: Your final exercise is to fight Queen Bibis and bring 4 Queen Bibi's Staffs to Raffle.

Name: quest_858
Description: Crune has related the legend of Hovert, the greatest Soldier who ever lived. It seems he left behind some mementos around Anima Lake after he passed away.

Name: quest_859
Description: After giving Hovert's mementos to Pein, he asked you to fulfill his grandfather's last request. Go and defeat 3 Aqua Captains!

Name: quest_860
Description: Pein was very pleased that you completed Hovert's final mission. He told you to visit Crune to receive a reward.

Name: quest_901
Description: Warren said that he'd recognize you as a Muse if you had a simple potion created for him. Let’s make one with Tryteh's help.

Name: quest_902
Description: Tryteh told you about a recipe for creating a simple sleeping potion. First, bring 20 Flanae Seeds to Tryteh.

Name: quest_903
Description: After receiving the Flanae Seeds, Tryteh has asked you to bring 5 Pumpkin Seeds. Fight Big Pumpkins to find some Pumpkin Seeds.

Name: quest_904
Description: Tryteh made a potion for you called the 'Nectar of Deep Sleep.' With this, Warren should allow you to become a Muse.

Name: quest_905
Description: Keenu asked if you could help Orias who is having trouble combating the strange forces in the El Verloon Desert.

Name: quest_906
Description: Orias said that he needs Stones of Nature to fight this strange force. Bring Orias 5 Stones of Nature from each of the following elements: Fire, Water and Earth. Fight Dalpings and Ranger Dalpings to find these Stones of Nature.

Name: quest_907
Description: Orias is very grateful for your help, but has nothing to give you in the middle of the desert. He's asked you to go to Keenu for your reward.

Name: quest_908
Description: Lisa asked you if you can help settle a dispute between Francis and Shroon. First, you should meet Shroon at the temple near Lake Anima.

Name: quest_909
Description: Shroon said that he'd never give up Anima Lake. You have to talk to Francis, the head of the Junon Order in Zant.

Name: quest_910
Description: Francis has accepted the Ikaness' suggestion and will delay the temple construction for 3 years to find and build a new place for the Ikaness to live. You should tell Shroon about this.

Name: quest_911
Description: Shroon has agreed with Francis' suggestion. To help prepare this new place for the Ikaness, you must kill 20 Porkies and 5 Porkie Hooligans.

Name: quest_912
Description: Shroon was very pleased to have this new place and is willing to leave Anima Lake for good. Now, you should go back to Francis and let him know of this.

Name: quest_951
Description: Reasoning that speed is essential for Hawkers, Warren has asked you to bring him a Tarren Earring from Shannon. You better head straight to the Tower of Luxem Valley.

Name: quest_952
Description: Before Shannon will give you to Tarren Earring, you must bring twenty 20 Crystal Dew. Hunt Mother Choropy, Spotted Choropy, and Jelly King to get Crystal Dew.

Name: quest_953
Description: You traded 20 Crystal Dew for the Tarren Earring. Now you should return to Warren who is waiting for you.

Name: quest_954
DisplayName: Why Did Toddy Steal the Jewels?
Description: Last night, Mina’s jewel shop was robbed. Toddy, the suspect, is said to have run away to the Breezy Hills. It's not too late to try to find him!

Name: quest_955
DisplayName: Why Did Toddy Steal the Jewels?
Description: That little boy Mile said that Toddy threw the jewels into the fields. Find 10 of Mina's Rubies. It's likely that the Dalpings have picked them up…

Name: quest_956
DisplayName: Why Did Toddy Steal the Jewels?
Description: Mina said that his Crystal Necklaces haven't been found yet. Find 7 Crystal Necklaces which were probably picked up by Beetle Fighters.

Name: quest_957
Description: Reasoning that speed is essential for Hawkers, Carrion wants to test your quickness with a special hunting challenge. He'll give you a reward if you defeat 10 Aqua Captains in 10 minutes.

Name: quest_958
Description: Carrion is a little disappointed but he'll give you another chance. Go and defeat 10 Aqua Captains in 15 minutes.

Name: quest_959
Description: Carrion will give you one last chance. You have 30 minutes to defeat 10 Aqua Captains. Remember, Carrion isn't going to give you any more chances!

Name: quest_1001
Description: Warren suggested that you meet Crow to learn about the basics of trading.

Name: quest_1002
Description: Crow asked you to bring him Fleece and Small Metal Boards, since their market prices have risen. For this, you need to meet Lampa in Zant Village, and Seyon in the Adventurer's Plains.

Name: quest_1003
Description: Crow asked you to bring him 15 HoneyBee Stingers. HoneyBee Stingers can found from hunting Needle HoneyBees.

Name: quest_1004
Description: Crow appreciates your work for getting him the materials, saying that he can sell them at a good price. He has written a recommendation that you can take to Warren to become a Dealer.

Name: quest_1005
Description: Ulysses said that Beetle Shells are selling for a good price lately. If you bring him 15 Beetle Shells from Beetle Fighters, he'll buy them from you for a good price.

Name: quest_1006
Description: Ulysses said that the Beetle Shell price has dropped. Instead, he's offering to give you Cobra Leather that you can sell in the Breezy Hills.

Name: quest_1007
Description: Mairard was very pleased with the Cobra Leather you've given him. Now, if you bring him some Dalping Eggs, he will give you a good weapon.

Name: quest_1008
Description: Crow told you that he can make you an Iron Rifle if you bring him 10 Aqua Molars. You can get Aqua Molars from Aqua Rangers and Aqua Hunters.

Name: quest_1049
Description: Darren, the mayor of Junon Polis, will test your abilities before you can change to the Second Job. First, you have to defeat 3 Guardian Trees and 3 Grunter Kings.

Name: quest_1050
Description: For Darren's second test, you must defeat 3 Junon's KingKongs and 3 Krawfy Kings.

Name: quest_1051
Description: Before giving you the Second Job, Darren wants you to meet and help Crune, a Weapon Merchant in Junon.

Name: quest_1052
Description: Before giving you the Second Job, Darren wants you to meet and help Lisa, a Designer in Junon.

Name: quest_1053
Description: Before giving you the Second Job, Darren wants you to meet and help Saki, an Armor Merchant in Junon.

Name: quest_1054
Description: Before giving you the Second Job, Darren wants you to meet and help Mildun, a Ferrell Guild Merchant in Junon.

Name: quest_1055
DisplayName: Lucid: King of Legend (Second Job Change)
Description: The world is beginning to forget the legend of King Lucid, one of the Seven Knights. To revive his memory in the hearts of the people, you must find Lucid's Crown.

Name: quest_1056
DisplayName: Lucid: King of Legend (Second Job Change)
Description: There's a story about Lucid where his sword was shattered after he drove it in the ground to signify the reunion of the Seven Knight

Name: quest_1057
DisplayName: Lucid: King of Legend (Second Job Change)
Description: Leonard has told you that the Goblins stole the broken pieces of Lucid's sword after they were hidden in the Goblin Cave. Go into the 2nd level of the Goblin Cave and find all 5 Fragments of Lucid's Sword.

Name: quest_1058
DisplayName: Lucid: King of Legend (Second Job Change)
Description: Leonard was greatly pleased that you found all the pieces of Lucid's Sword. Now you should go to Breezy Hills and ask Mairath to restore Lucid's Sword.

Name: quest_1059
DisplayName: Lucid: King of Legend (Second Job Change)
Description: Mairath said that the magic in the Token of Friendship is necessary to restore Lucid's Sword. You might be able to find the Token of Friendship in the Gorge of Silence.

Name: quest_1060
DisplayName: Lucid: King of Legend (Second Job Change)
Description: Mairath has restored Lucid's Sword using the sword fragments and the Token of Friendship. Although the idea of keeping the sword is tempting, you should donate it to the Kingdom's Museum by speaking to Jones.

Name: quest_1061
DisplayName: Lucid: King of Legend (Second Job Change)
Description: Jones has written a recommendation for you. Show it to Darren in Junon Polis so you that you will be able to change to the Second Job.

Name: quest_1062
DisplayName: Namielle: Mother of All (Second Job Change)
Description: During her adventures with the Seven Knights, Namielle invented many spells that were never passed down. However, the secrets to her legendary magic are supposedly hidden in the Old Priest

Name: quest_1063
DisplayName: Namielle: Mother of All (Second Job Change)
Description: When a faction of the Seven Heroes was opposed to embarking on the Second Expedition, Namielle destroyed her own wedding ring with Lucid's Sword to illustrate her dedication and willingness to sacrifice. However, t

Name: quest_1064
DisplayName: Namielle: Mother of All (Second Job Change)
Description: Mina is certain that Namielle's Wedding Ring still exists and suggested that you investigate the Goblin Warriors in the 2nd level of the Goblin Cave.

Name: quest_1065
DisplayName: Namielle: Mother of All (Second Job Change)
Description: In the interest of preventing the disparaging rumors about Namielle from gaining credibility, Mina has decided to safeguard Namielle's Wedding Ring. However, another cause for concern in regards to Namielle

Name: quest_1066
DisplayName: Namielle: Mother of All (Second Job Change)
Description: Lutis said that you might be able to find the Hairpins of Oblivious by hunting Stone Golems in the Gorge of Silence. When you find 5 Hairpins of Oblivious, return to Mina.

Name: quest_1067
DisplayName: Namielle: Mother of All (Second Job Change)
Description: Mina has praised your heroic activities and suggested that you change to the Second Job. Mina has even written you a recommendation letter that you can show to Darren in Junon Polis for the job change.

Name: quest_1068
Description: When you inquired about the Second Job, Saki told you about Kirnale, the legendary explorer. Upon hearing of Kirnale's exploits, you wanted to see the long lost Port

Name: quest_1069
Description: After bringing Kirnale's relics to Saki, Saki suggested that these artifacts be placed in the care of Jones, the historian in Junon Polis. You should go and visit Jones and perhaps you'll get the chance to read some of Kirnale's Journals.

Name: quest_1070
Description: Jones said that he finally lent Kirnale's Journals to a stubborn adventurer who managed to lose them in the Goblin Cave. Hurry and search the 2nd level of the Goblin Cave for Kirnale's Journals!

Name: quest_1071
Description: You found Kirnale's Journals and returned them to Jones, asking him not to lose them again. Jones then suggested that you visit Sharlin, the tavern owner in Zant, if you want to hear the story of Kirnale and Lillith.

Name: quest_1072
Description: The story that Sharlin told you about Kirnale and Lillith was really romantic. She seemed really eager to see the Phoenix Writing Quill that Kirnale gave to Lillith. Search the Gorge of Silence to see if you can find it.

Name: quest_1073
Description: After giving her the Phoenix Writing Quill, Sharlin has written a recommendation for you. Take her recommendation letter to Darren, mayor of Junon Polis, so that you can change to the Second Job.

Name: quest_1074
DisplayName: Lillith, Woman of the Cosmos (Second Job Change)
Description: Mildun has asked you to search for Lillith's Family Emblem in order to restore her honor. Investigate the Goblin Warriors in the Goblin Cave (B2) and find the Family Emblem to restore Lillith's legend.

Name: quest_1075
DisplayName: Lillith, Woman of the Cosmos (Second Job Change)
Description: After giving Mildun the Family Emblem that belonged to Lillith, he told you the bittersweet story of Lillith's love for Kirnale. Visit Hotch in Kenji's Beach to see if he'll let you read one of the love letters Lillith sent to Kirnale.

Name: quest_1076
DisplayName: Lillith, Woman of the Cosmos (Second Job Change)
Description: Hotch has told you that the Krawfies stole the love letters written by Lillith that he has collected. You've got to recover 5 Bottled Love Letters from Krawfy Kings.

Name: quest_1077
DisplayName: Lillith, Woman of the Cosmos (Second Job Change)
Description: After retrieving the love letters, Hotch has told you to bring them to Jones, the historian in Junon Polis, so that he can take good care of these historical relics.

Name: quest_1078
DisplayName: Lillith, Woman of the Cosmos (Second Job Change)
Description: Jones expressed regret that Lillith's love story is more famous that her contributions to the Akram Kingdom. He suggested that you find Lillith's Scales in order to raise recognition of Li

Name: quest_1079
DisplayName: Lillith, Woman of the Cosmos (Second Job Change)
Description: Jones praised your efforts, and believed it was a good time for you to be promoted. He's written a recommendation letter that you can take to Darren in Junon Polis so that you can change to the Second Job.

Name: quest_1100
Description: You discovered a man called Osiris and a big artifact in Junon Fields. He has lost his memory and can't tell you why he is there. He needs some food. Speak to Reene at Junon Fields.

Name: quest_1101
Description: Reene is out of fish. Go to Anima Lake and hunt 10 fish from Aqua Guard.

Name: quest_1102
Description: You brought 10 Fish to Reene. Now go back to Osiris and give him the Fish.

Name: quest_1103
Description: You gave the fish to Osiris but he still can't remember anything. He gave you his brooch to show to a minister. Nearest minister is Mairard at Junon Fields.

Name: quest_1104
Description: Mairard recommended that you speak to Jones, a historian of Junon. He can be found investigating the pyramid at El Verloon Desert.

Name: quest_1105
Description: Jones told you to visit the Wisdom Tree at Forest of Wisdom to see if he can tell you more.

Name: quest_1106
Description: The Wisdom Tree's guardian Fandral told you about the Royal Family of Oro and the truth about Osiris. Time to go back to Osiris at Junon Fields and tell him what you've learnt.

Name: quest_1107
Description: Osiris told you about the ritual of his family. You must go to the Ancient Pyramid at El Verloon Desert and find one of the Ancient Guardians.

Name: quest_1108
Description: The guardian told you to find the Salamander Flame within the Pyramid and place the Royal Sword through it and then bring back the Firelord's choker.

Name: quest_1109
Description: You must search the beaches and land around the stone statues at Kenji Beach for a Tablet left by the ancients.

Name: quest_1110
Description: You discovered a tablet near the beach. You must now show this to Osiris at Junon Fields.

Name: quest_1111
Description: Osiris has asked you to travel to Oro and help him further there. Take these flight blueprints to Ruven at Junon Polis and he will be able to take you to Oro.

Name: quest_1189
Description: Kill all the players you see!

Name: quest_1190
Description: Kill all the players you see!

Name: quest_1191
Description: Your objective is to protect your crystals and kill all the crystals of your opponent, after killing the 3 crystals the main crystal will spawn at the center of the map you need to destroy the last crystal in order to win

Name: quest_1192
Description: Your objective is to protect your crystals and kill all the crystals of your opponent, after killing the 3 crystals the main crystal will spawn at the center of the map you need to destroy the last crystal in order to win

Name: quest_1200
Description: Your task is to travel to Junon Clanfield and kill each of the 5 Guardians then report back to the battleground.

Name: quest_1201
Description: Go to Luna Clanfield and slay the Astarot King.

Name: quest_1202
Description: You must hunt 100 of the Fallen Visitors then report back to a Battleground Staff Member.

Name: quest_1203
Description: You must go to Eldeon Clanfield and speak to Jess. She has a job for you.

Name: quest_1205
Description: You must go to Eldeon Clanfield and speak to Guduka. He has a challenge for you.

Name: quest_1208
Description: Jess is running low on potions and she needs to produce more. Hunt Hook, Pincer and Nepenthes guardians for the 3 materials.

Name: quest_1209
Description: You completed the task Jess set you. Go speak to a Battleground Staff member to finish the quest and recieve funds!

Name: quest_1211
Description: Somewhere within the clanfield is a Turak Guardian. Find him and defeat him then return to Guduka.

Name: quest_1212
Description: You completed Guduka's challenge. Head back to the battleground to recieve your reward.

Name: quest_1980
Description: Years of exhaust from Mana Engines have mutated the Devil Pest virus, creating a new breed of incredibly dangerous monsters. Hunt down these monsters and bring 5 Proofs of Monst

Name: quest_1981
Description: Punwell says that the Zeppastone Wind Gem is necessary for the prosperity of the Windmill Village. All you know is that the Zeppastone should be in a dark, enclosed place.

Name: quest_1982
Description: After recovering the Zeppastone, you hear about the runaway Prince of Akram. You should try to talk to Odelo, a Guard in Junon Polis, to learn more.

Name: quest_1983
Description: Odelo said that the only trace of the Prince is a Golden Dagger kept by Gallahad in Kenji's Beach.

Name: quest_1984
Description: Gallahad suggests that you investigate the area around the Kenji Stone. Find out what you can over there, and return to Gallahad.

Name: quest_1985
DisplayName: The Truth of the Golden Dagger
Description: To find out the truth about the Golden Dagger, you should talk to Lutis, who is in the Valley of Luxem Tower.

Name: quest_1986
Description: Lutis started babbling about Luna, but maybe you should visit that planet someday. Now you need to speak to Winters, a Guard in Junon Polis, to continue your search for information on the Golden Dagger.

Name: quest_1987
DisplayName: The Truth of the Golden Dagger (2)
Description: You should ask Winters, a Soldier in Junon Polis, about the Golden Dagger.

Name: quest_1988
Description: Winters recommended that you see Pavrick, the best craftsman in Luna, to check the Golden Dagger's authenticity. You must ask Alphonso to guide you to Luna.

Name: quest_1989
Description: Pavrick confirmed that the Golden Dagger really did belong to the royal family. Hence, the warrior who saved Kenji's Beach was the Prince. But where is he now? First, you need to return the Golden Dagger to Gallahad.

Name: quest_2000
Description: Mr. Spero told you about Woopies and Woppie Chefs made mess out of his lab and have stolen vaccine gun drawings. Let's get 2 drawings back from them who are wandering around Zant.

Name: quest_2001
Description: Mr. Spero asked you to bring a report about darkness form Tryteh who works for Arumic. It seems Mr. Spero and Arumic inventor are in bad relationship. Are you sure you can do this?

Name: quest_2002
Description: Tryteh says that you need to bring a certificate from chief of this village. You better ask Cornell about this.

Name: quest_2003
Description: Cornell says if you hand his letter to Lutis at the Tower of Luxem, he will help you.

Name: quest_2004
Description: Lutis seems he can not accept what the letter says. You need to go to Cornell again.

Name: quest_2005
Description: Cornell seemed very upset about Lutis's feed back but fortunately, you get your certificate. Let's go to Tryteh.

Name: quest_2006
Description: Tryteh gave you the report as she promised. You feel dangerous about this. Better run to Mr. Spero.

Name: quest_2007
Description: Mr.Spero send you to Belz who stays at the Breezi Hills for some information about capturing Dalping.

Name: quest_2008
Description: Lazy Belz! He's irresponsible. Now you have to capture 10 Dalpings which supposed to be his job.

Name: quest_2009
Description: Now, you finished capturing Dalping. You can go to Mr.Spero. Is he sure for Vaccine this time?

Name: quest_2010
Description: Finally vaccine is completed! But still not sure about effects.Why don't you try it on Rackies? Mr.Spero says you better try more than 10 times.

Name: quest_2011
Description: Vaccine surely worked! But Rackie died just after his devil pest was cured. Why? You gotta tell Mr.Spero about this.

Name: quest_2051
Description: Ishtal, the Eucar Judge, has asked you to excavate Shamanic Artifacts in the Forgotten Temple in order to reconstruct forgotten shamanist history. While you're there, he'd like you to clear out any thieves in the Forgotten Temple that you can find.

Name: quest_2751
Description: Burtland the Clan owner asked you to collect items that are necessary for Clan House Extension in order to raise your Clan Grade to 3. You are required to bring 600 Silver Iron, 400 Pine Wood and 10 Blue Crystals. These are normal items, not quest items.

Name: quest_2752
Description: Burtland the Clan owner asked you to collect items that are necessary for Clan House Extension in order to raise your Clan Grade to 3. You are required to bring 200 Steel, 150 Cinnamon Wood and 50 Earth Stones. These are normal items, not quest items.

Name: quest_2753
Description: Burtland the Clan owner asked you to collect items that are necessary for Clan House Extension in order to raise your Clan Grade to 3. You are required to bring 50 Chromium, 100 Molive and 2 Green Hearts. These are normal items, not quest items.

Name: quest_2851
Description: Both the Righteous Crusaders and the Ferrell Guild have blasphemed the Junon Order, and they must be punished in the name of Junon. Let them feel our righteous wrath!

Name: quest_2852
Description: Though the Righteous Crusaders and the Ferrell Guild threaten us, they are nothing compared to the holiness that is our protection. Let us fight for the sake of the Junon Order!

Name: quest_2853
Description: That hypocritical Junon Order is raising an army to wipe us out! Well, let's show them that true defenders of justice will never bend to their will!

Name: quest_2854
Description: It's lonely to be number one, and you'll always have enemies. Let's show that jealous Junon Order just how powerful we really are, and confirm our superiority!

Name: quest_2855
Description: The Arumics have been greatly aided by the Junon Order ever since our organization has left Luna and come to Junon. We've got swallow our pride and return

Name: quest_2856
Description: The Righteous Crusaders and Ferrell Guild have taken our magic lightly, but were frequently defeated when they challenged us. Once again, they must be taught the reality of Mana Theory. Let us show them the true power of Arumic magic!

Name: quest_2857
Description: The Junon Order and the Arumics attacked us by surprise and seized one of our most important trade routes, the Ferrell Road. Let's show them how powerful the Ferrell Guild really is, and take back Ferrell Road!

Name: quest_2858
Description: That foolish Junon Order and the Arumics don't give us any respect or recognition. They underestimate us and don't understand the power of wealth. Let's show them that the Ferrell Guild is a force to be reckoned with!

Name: quest_3001
Description: Shannon has been saving the lives of Visitors for a long time in the Valley of Luxem Tower. Gorthein wants you to help by bringing medical supplies to Shannon.

Name: quest_3002
Description: Gorthein has always wished to make his own healing potion, but he's always failed. Now, he's running out of materials to continue his experiments. Help Gorthein by supplying him with 10 Porkie Spines.

Name: quest_3003
Description: Help the effort to construct a new shrine for the Junon Order by hunting Smoulies and gathering 12 Thick Pulpwood.

Name: quest_3004
Description: Whenever a new Junon Scripture is released, Gorthein sends a copy to Kay. Now, you must travel to the Forest of Wisdom so that you can deliver the Junon Scripture to Kay.

Name: quest_3005
Description: Help the effort to construct a new shrine for the Junon Order by hunting Grunter Warriors and gathering 18 Iron Fragments.

Name: quest_3006
Description: As antagonism between soldiers of opposing Factions increases, it seems that war will soon break out. The Junon Order is said to win every battle, so long as ev

Name: quest_3007
Description: In order to return to Luna, the Arumics have secretly been constructing a Flying Ship. As their ally, the Arumics have asked the Junon Or

Name: quest_3101
Description: Those Self Righteous Crusaders have declared war on the Junon Order! Let's make an example of those thrill-seeking warmongers.

Name: quest_3102
Description: Those schemers in the Junon Order have been raising an army in secret! We've got to stop them before they grow too powerful!

Name: quest_3401
Description: Porkies have recently been bullying and tormenting the innocent. Let's show them what we do to oppressors, and kill 17 of them!

Name: quest_3402
Description: The Moldies that have left the Coal Mines haven't been able to adapt to the outside world. They shouldn't be wandering around and bothering people, so go out and punish 30 of them.

Name: quest_3403
Description: Recently, we haven't been able to provide enough training weapons for new recruits in the Righteous Crusaders. For this purpose, go out and bring back 16 Grunter Axes.

Name: quest_3404
Description: Lately, word has been going around that those Porkies have been mugging and harassing the innocent. Let's kill at least 30 Porkie Hooligans and show them we mean business.

Name: quest_3405
Description: Lately, we've been having trouble supplying training equipment for new recruits in the Righteous Crusaders. Help us out by hunting Grunter Warriors and bringing back 8 Training Gloves.

Name: quest_3406
Description: We've got to keep training if we're going to mete out justice to the Junon Order that opposes us. Defeating 45 Elder Doongas might be rigorous training, but let's do it with pride as Righteous Crusaders.

Name: quest_3407
Description: To improve our chances in Faction conflicts, the Righteous Crusaders have decided to get new equipment. Help create new weapons by supplying 30 Krawfy Hard Shells from hunting Krawfy Warriors.

Name: quest_3601
Description: Porkie Spines are often useful as a magic ingredient. So go out and beat some Porkie Hooligans and bring back 10 Porkie Spines.

Name: quest_3602
DisplayName: Coal Mine Moldies under Arumic Watch
Description: The Arumics have started research on the strange behavior of Moldies in the Coal Mines. Gather 12 Moldie Eyelashes as specimens for study.

Name: quest_3603
Description: The Arumics have decided to research the Grunter Fighters' mysterious strength in an attempt to discover the source of their power. Help the research efforts by collecting 14 Grunter Feet.

Name: quest_3604
Description: Lutis, the astronomer in Luxem Tower, has recently been having trouble focusing Mana energy. You've got to help by giving Lutis the Mana Focus Potion.

Name: quest_3605
Description: Extracting the magical essence from plants is one of the basics of magic research. Go and hunt Smoulies in order to bring back 13 Smouly Leaves.

Name: quest_3606
Description: The Righteous Crusaders have been waiting for their chance to crush our allies, the Junon Order. The Arumics have to help the Junon

Name: quest_3607
Description: We've been unsuccessful in receiving Mana Wave messages from the planet of Luna, so we must construct a Mana Tower to receive these we

Name: quest_3801
DisplayName: It Might be Worth More Later
Description: Since demand for Porkie Spines is on the rise, it's time to get them while they're still hot. Go hunt some Porkies and get 12 Porkie Spines.

Name: quest_3802
Description: It's expected that the price for coal will rise since the Moldies have stopped mining for coal. You should chase after those Moldies and try to get 10 High Quality Coal as quickly as you can!

Name: quest_3803
Description: The Ferrell Guild isn't all business: apparently our leaders see the need for a place to relax. Help out with the lounge construction by hunting Smoulies to collect 12 Thick Pulpwood.

Name: quest_3804
DisplayName: Charrs' Elaborate Market Price Analysis Table
Description: Belz, in the Breezy Hills, has requested Charrs' Market Price Analysis Table. Your job is to make sure it's delivered to Belz.

Name: quest_3805
Description: As the Ferrell Guild becomes more frequently targeted for robbery, its merchants must be equipped with guns to protect themselves. For this purpose, collect 17 Iron Fragments by hunting Grunter Warriors to help create more guns.

Name: quest_3806
Description: The Ferrell Guild can't idly stand by while the Junon Order targets the Righteous Crusaders! Help our allies by defeating Elder Doongas to collect 20 Doonga's Sausages for emergency rations.

Name: quest_3807
Description: The Ferrell Guild has decided to create new healing potions to help their long time allies, the Righteous Crusaders, in the Faction Wars. Do your part by bringing 30 units of Sticky Fluid that can be obtained from Kaiman Warriors.

Name: quest_5001
Description: Sharlin asked you if you can bring two bottles of wine to Punwell in the Breezy Hills. You have a total of 30 minutes to finish this delivery.

Name: quest_5002
Description: Raffle asked you to bring him 10 Pomic Skins, and will give you a better reward if you can complete this task earlier than your rivals.

Name: quest_5003
Description: Keenu has a weakness for Dalping Eggs. Bring him 13 Dalping Eggs, and he'll give you a reward depending on how much sooner you bring him the eggs than your rivals.

Name: quest_5004
Description: Ulysses has asked you to deliver his Daily Price Checklist to Seyon in the Adventurer's Plains.

Name: quest_5005
Description: Spero has asked you to deliver his Top Secret Cart Schematic to Belz, who is in the Windmill Village in the Breezy Hills.

Name: quest_5006
Description: Lena has asked you to gather Bronze Fragments to help alleviate the dwindling supply problem in Zant. You can hunt Pomic type monsters to obtain Bronze Fragments.

Name: quest_5007
Description: Lena has asked you to gather Iron Fragments to help alleviate the dwindling supply problem in Zant. You can hunt Red Flanae, Old Flanae, Big Flanae and Beetles to obtain Iron Fragments.

Name: quest_5008
Description: Lena has asked you to gather Silver Fragments to help alleviate the dwindling supply problem in Zant. You can hunt Rackie and Turtle type monsters to obtain Silver Fragments.

Name: quest_5009
Description: Cornell, the mayor of Zant, has organized a campaign to exterminate the Candle Ghosts. Bring him 20 Candle Ghost Masks from the Candle Ghosts you've defeated, and he'll reward you according to your performance in comparison to your competition.

Name: quest_5011
Description: More material shortages have occurred in Junon Polis as its population has risen. If you bring Maple Branches to Eva, she will surely be pleased. You can find Maple Branches by hunting Porkie type monsters.

Name: quest_5012
Description: More material shortages have occurred in Junon Polis as its population has risen. If you bring Konara Branches to Eva, she will surely be pleased. You can find Konara Branches by hunting Clown type monsters.

Name: quest_5013
Description: More material shortages have occurred in Junon Polis as its population has risen. If you bring Oak Branches to Eva, she will surely be pleased. You can find Oak Branches by hunting Doonga type monsters.

Name: quest_5014
Description: The Goblin Cave (B1) is teeming with Rubies that have been dug up by the Goblins. However, Goblins merely hold on to these jewels and don't know what to do with them. Bring a bunch of Small Rubies to Bellia, and he might pay you a good price for them.

Name: quest_5015
Description: The Goblin Cave (B2) is teeming with Topaz that has been dug up by the Goblins. However, Goblins merely hold on to these jewels and don't know what to do with them. Bring a bunch of Small Topazes to Bellia, and he might pay you a good price for them.

Name: quest_5016
Description: The Goblin Cave (B2) is teeming with Diamonds that have been dug up by the Goblins. However, Goblins merely hold on to these jewels and don't know what to do with them. Bring a bunch of Small Diamonds to Bellia, and he might pay you a good price for them.

Name: quest_5017
Description: Kiroth has told you that Moldies have been gathering some strange mineral. If you bring 10 Green Minerals and 10 Black Minerals to Kiroth, he will reward you according to your performance compared to your rivals.

Name: quest_5018
Description: No one has ever seen the true form of the Candle Ghosts that appear at night, so it might be a good idea to remove a bunch of their masks. Bring 20 Candle Ghost Masks to Hayen for a reward.

Name: quest_5019
Description: Itz, who has a weakness for gambling, has created this game of chance. Defeat 55 Goblins in the Goblin Cave (B2) for a possible reward.

Name: quest_5031
Description: Seyon has asked you to deliver the Daily Price Check to Ulysses in Zant.

Name: quest_5032
Description: Bring Gray's Pearl Oysters to Francis who is at the temple in Zant. Afterwards, return to Gray with the Elder Appointment Letter from Francis.

Name: quest_5033
Description: With the endless influx of Visitors, the Adventurer's Plains is suffering from a supply shortage. Collect some Jelly Bean Hides for the overtaxed Gray and provide him with some relief.

Name: quest_5034
Description: With the endless influx of Visitors, the Adventurer's Plains is suffering from a supply shortage. Collect some Spools of Thread from Choropies for the worrisome Gray and provide him with some relief.

Name: quest_5035
Description: With the endless influx of Visitors, the Adventurer's Plains is suffering from a supply shortage. Collect some Flanae Petals for the tormented Gray and provide him with some relief.

Name: quest_5041
Description: Methio lost the engagement ring and without it, he'll never be able to face his fiancee again. You've got to find Methio's Engagement Ring for him.

Name: quest_5051
Description: The Fairy of Arua suggested that you defeat 3 Jelly Beans in preparation for your real adventures. Complete this task and you'll receive a small reward.

Name: quest_5052
Description: The Fairy of Arua suggested that you defeat 4 Mini-Choropies in preparation for your real adventures. Complete this task and you'll receive a small reward.

Name: quest_5053
Description: The Fairy of Arua suggested that you defeat 8 Choropies and Mini-Choropies in preparation for your real adventures. Complete this task and you'll receive a small reward.

Name: quest_5061
Description: Santa needs your help! Travel to each of the 4 planetoids and bring back those stolen items!

Name: quest_5064
Description: Every spring, Judy used to make a bunch of flowers for her grandfather. But this time she has a bad cold, so she's asking you to collect 20 Cherry Blossoms. You can get Cherry Blossoms by hunting Cherry Smoulies.

Name: quest_5065
Description: Judy asks you once again to gather 20 Cherry Blossoms, this time for Mayor Darren of Junon Polis. Hunt those Cherry Smoulies to get those flowers!

Name: quest_5066
Description: Santa needs your help! Travel to each of the 4 planetoids and bring back those stolen items!

Name: quest_5067
Description: Reene's sister, Lithia has gone missing. Reene recommended that you start searching north of Anima Lake for her.

Name: quest_5068
Description: Lithia told you how she got killed by Evil Jack and now has to live as a ghost at the Desert of the Dead. Time to report back to Reene and tell her the bad news.

Name: quest_5069
Description: Rosie, Arisa's teddybear has been stolen by the Aqua King at El Verloon Desert. Go rescue Rosie!

Name: quest_5072
Description: Every Valentine's Day, Judy used to hand out Love Bags to the couples. But this time Love Pigs have gone and taken them, so she's asking you to collect at least 35 Red Love Bags for her. You can find Love Pigs at Love Island.
